title: dfilter: Make NaN equality comparison more intuitive
description:
Instead of having NaNs compare equal to every other floating point
value, which is just kind of broken, implement the more natural
equality comparison
  NaN == NaN → true
  NaN == 2.0 → false
  etc.

Note that this does not conform to IEEE 754 semantics where NaN
is different from every other value. The equality operator is
implemented like the isnan() function instead.

Fixes #20623.

notes.body: @johnthacker When you can please have a look and let me know what you think.
This type does have a NaN, though the implementation also imposes a total ordering on them, so maybe that's ok. I haven't looked at it more closely than that.
I know, I should have added a TODO for that. I don't intend to work on it myself.
Might be reasonable to have `G_UNLIKELY` here as a compiler hint.
